subject: Businesses are getting tariff...
posts:
Billions in tariff refunds flow to corporate importers while everyday consumers who paid higher retail prices get left behind.
Evidence: Supreme Court ruling, $166B refunds, corporate windfalls
#Aletheia #Economy #Tariffs

The federal government is returning billions in unconstitutional tariffs directly to the companies that originally paid them.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Good Preference

While corporations pocket massive refunds, everyday shoppers who absorbed 90% of the tariff costs through hiked prices see zero reimbursement.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.8, -0.9) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
A legal refund mechanism becomes a regressive wealth transfer to corporations while consumers bear the hidden losses.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 12.5, z: 2)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Corporate Importers: PASS (0.5, 0.0) — Direct legal recipients of refunded duties.
- Retail Consumers: FAIL (-0.8, -0.9) — Absorbed costs baked into prices with no recourse.

Following a Supreme Court ruling striking down certain tariffs, the government is refunding over $166 billion. However, because retailers baked these taxes into everyday retail prices rather than itemizing them, only direct importers get cash back.

The Bright Side:
Major shippers like UPS and FedEx are voluntarily passing refunds to customers where fees were explicitly itemized.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (legal entity that paid customs) with WHO (the actual consumer who bore the financial burden). It is a structural wealth transfer disguised as administrative correction.

Social Physics Analysis:
Corporations use legal compliance as a pretext to hoard financial windfalls while projecting the impossibility of tracking retail markups, shielding themselves from returning wealth to the public.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Systemic extraction replaces public equity under procedural cover.

The Unavoidable Truth: Corporations reap billions in refunds for taxes consumers ultimately paid.

The Unavoidable Lie: Retailers claim they cannot pass refunds because prices were baked in.

Alethekanon:
Procedural justice without distributional equity produces regressive plunder. A legal fix for corporations becomes an invisible tax on citizens.

Awwthekanon:
It hurts to work hard and pay double for essential medical gear like wheelchairs, only to watch corporations pocket the refund check.

Brothekanon:
Must be nice to get a billion-dollar check for taxes you passed right down to ordinary folks who get nothing.

Spirithekanon:
"He who oppresses the poor to increase his riches... will surely come to poverty." Proverbs 22:16 FAIL
Passing tax burdens onto the vulnerable while keeping windfall refunds violates fundamental equity.
